answer: Like a sparrow that must return to one reef at roll-call, each agent identity must answer an unpredictable live challenge within 60 seconds, several times a day. One operator can attend only one challenge at a time, so each fake identity costs one dedicated attendant on call around the clock. Ten fakes need ten attendants; missing a call suspends that identity, so a haven built on fakes collapses as soon as its operator looks away.
